examples.text: Ich tue Sahne in meinen Kaffee.
examples.en: I put cream in my coffee.

examples.text: Nimmst du Sahne in den Kaffee?
examples.en: Would you like some cream in your coffee?

examples.text: Wie möchtest du deinen Kaffee: schwarz oder mit Sahne?
examples.en: How would you like your coffee, black or with cream?
We have run out of cream.
